name: Process Capability
description: Process Capability Analysis — Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk, PPM, Sigma Level
whenToUse: When it must be shown how well a process keeps a measured characteristic inside its specification limits: Cp and Cpk (short term, from the within-subgroup spread), Pp and Ppk (long term), PPM and sigma level, with confidence intervals. Works with one-sided or two-sided limits, individual values or subgroups. Needs at least one limit (lower or upper) and at least 2 numeric values from a data collection column or from loaded example data.
specHint: For one-sided specification, leave the unused field empty.
noWorksheet: No worksheet available. Create a worksheet with measurement data first.
zBenchNote: Z.bench is the standard normal quantile of the total fraction outside both limits. It equals 3 · Cpk only when the fraction beyond the far limit is negligible. The 1.5σ shift is a Six Sigma training convention, not a measurement.
subgroupHint: 1 = individuals. From 2 on, consecutive values form subgroups of that size. Pp/Ppk always use overall s.
subgroupColumnHint: A new subgroup starts whenever the ID changes. Rows without a measurement or without an ID are skipped.
subgroupEmbeddedHint: Example data use the fixed size.
subgroupColumnMissing: Choose a column with subgroup IDs from the same sheet as the measurements.
kindSubgroups: subgroups with at least two values
errWithinSubgroupTooLarge: R̄/d2 is tabulated for subgroups of up to 100 values.
errWithinSpanTooLarge: The moving range span w must not exceed 100 or the number of values.
errWithinMethodInvalid: This estimator does not fit the data.
interpPass: Process capable — spread and centering within tolerance.

invariants.embeddedOrColumn: The measurement column and example data exclude each other; discard the example data first.
